sys_scope.name: TestReach
sys_scope.description: ATF Coverage Analyzer & Test Gap Detector — maps every business rule, script include, client script, flow, and UI action to the ATF tests that exercise it, then surfaces gaps as a heatmap, upgrade risk score, and auto-generated test skeletons.
sys_scope.release_notes: Initial release: static coverage analysis, risk scoring, upgrade gap detection, AI-powered test skeleton generation, CI/CD integration API.
